description: Static emitted arithmetic counts. Conventional FMA=2; weighted FMA=1. Distance geometry is evaluated inside direct kernels and excluded from DAG counts.

spherical.description: Exact live emitted arithmetic per lane, including geometry and output accumulation. Unary signs, copies, comparisons and selects cost zero. Division by square root costs eight. These weighted costs are not measured timings.

basisConversion.description: Exact sparse basis casts; return coefficients at the same center and units. No coordinate, potential or background scaling. Source dipoles always retained.

cartesianTracefree.description: Static emitted arithmetic counts. Conventional FMA=2; weighted FMA=1. Distance geometry is evaluated inside direct kernels and excluded from DAG counts.
